parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.config.model, stream: false, think: false, options: { temperature: 0, num_predict: 400 }, format: $json.config.parse_schema, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.config.parse_system }, { role: 'user', content: 'Company: ' + $json.company + '\nWebsite: ' + $json.website + '\nBrief: ' + $json.brief } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.config.model, stream: false, think: false, options: { temperature: 0.4, num_predict: 700 }, format: $json.config.concept_schema, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.config.concept_system }, { role: 'user', content: 'Client: ' + $json.name + ' at ' + $json.company + '\nSpec: ' + JSON.stringify($json.spec) } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ text: ':fire: ' + $('Build row').item.json.company + ' scored ' + $('Build row').item.json.lead_score + '/100 (' + $('Build row').item.json.spec.formats.join(', ') + '). Draft reply ready: ' + $('Build row').item.json.reply.subject }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, brief_id: $('Build row').item.json.brief_id, status: $('Build row').item.json.status, lead_score: $('Build row').item.json.lead_score, priority: $('Build row').item.json.priority, missing: $('Build row').item.json.missing, spec: $('Build row').item.json.spec, concepts: $('Build row').item.json.concepts, reply: $('Build row').item.json.reply, usage: $('Build row').item.json.usage } }}
={{ { ok: false, brief_id: $('Format error').item.json.brief_id, error: 'processing failed; the team has been alerted' } }}
